push.title: L 2-3 vs Sapa Boys | You: 8.1 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, your best match performance of the season at 8.1. Good as gold.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ That connection with PhogsToffees is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ On-ball actions 37, up from your usual 29. More of that, please and thank you.
+ 2 of the team's 4 tackles won: the team ran through you. Proof you've got another gear.
+ 3 goals conceded bumped you +0.1. Love it.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Repeat after me: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. You know you can.
- Heads up, you and BellyTb1: shot selection. Simple fix: cut it back to each other.
- In our wins you average 5 misplaced passes; here it was 8. Mark my words: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- 2 tackles won took 0.2. Better decisions, better rating.
- Your 3rd straight loss. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.

Backyard drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Enjoy it tonight. You earned it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs Sapa Boys | You: 8.1 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your best match performance of the season, PhogsToffees. An 8.1 against Sapa Boys, and you looked like you belonged.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Sapa Boys's goal. Their defense never got a moment of peace.
+ 2 key passes. Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ You and BellyTb1 speak the same football language.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ 5th straight match at 80% pass accuracy. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Game plan: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. Like riding a bike.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Write this down: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- Your 7th straight loss. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Lowest on-ball actions on the team: 34 (best was BellyTb1's 38). We'll drill that till it's boring.
- A one-goal loss (2-3): a single moment decided it. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.

Muscle memory: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.

Remember, PhogsToffees: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Keep writing those happy chapters. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs Sapa Boys | You: 8.0 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your best match performance of the season with an 8.0. Sweet as sun tea.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Sapa Boys's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ Tackles attempted 8, up from your usual 3. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Pass accuracy 88%, up from your usual 73%. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ 3 goals conceded: +0.1. That's how good ratings get built.

THE BAD
- 1 of 6 shots on target. Low-hanging fruit: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- Won 2 of 8 tackles (up from your usual 17%). Focus point: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- You and buddskees: shot selection. Two-person fix: cut it back to each other.
- Your 7th straight loss. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.0 (best was buddskees's 8.1). That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.

Coach's drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Hey, BellyTb1. A goal is just a pass to the net.

Good game, great person, bright future. - Coach Lasso
